description: This file contains string utility functions for string manipulation, including splitting, trimming, prefix/suffix checks, hex conversion, file reading, and substring replacement, within the 'angle' namespace.

methods.name: SplitString
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on delimiters, with options for whitespace trimming and result filtering.

methods.name: SplitStringAlongWhitespace
methods.description: Splits input string into tokens based on whitespace characters.

methods.name: TrimString
methods.description: Removes specified characters from the beginning and end of a string.

methods.name: GetPrefix
methods.description: Extracts a prefix from a string up to a delimiter, supporting both string and character delimiters.

methods.name: HexStringToUInt
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to an unsigned integer.

methods.name: ReadFileToString
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string.

methods.name: BeginsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string or C-string begins with a specified prefix.

methods.name: EndsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: ReplaceSubstring
methods.description: Replaces the first occurrence of a substring within a string with another substring.
